feeds.title: Log Cabin Homes Magazine
feeds.description: Your #1 guide for log home building. Everything you need to know to design, build and maintain your log & timber home. Each issue is packed with photos of log homes, hundreds of great design ideas, floorplans and more.

feeds.title: Timberhaven Log Homes Blog
feeds.description: Timberhaven Log & Timber Homes, LLC. is your choice for quality, affordable kiln-dried log homes, log cabins, timber frame homes, and timber accents. imberhaven Log Homes are one of the finest log home builders in America. Featuring kiln-dried, laminated logs, and custom designs.

feeds.title: Frontier Log Homes News
feeds.description: Frontier Log Homes have been in business in Western Colorado since 1977. We have provided log home kits to builders and homeowners nationwide. Whether you plan to build a small cabin or a large luxurious log home, Frontier Log Homes will exceed your expectations of quality and service. Get tips and the latest news surrounding log homes and log home construction. Learn more about how a log home can be a great project and house.

feeds.title: TruLog Siding Blog
feeds.description: The TruLog mission is to help fulfill our customers' dream of owning a maintenance-free log home by providing an authentic log home look through a maintenance-free, steel log panel. Read our blogs that tell about steel log siding, log cabins in Colorado, home repair tips, and everything TruLog Siding related.

feeds.title: Timber Building Specialists Blog
feeds.description: Timber Building Specialists supply garden log cabins and timber buildings at affordable prices. We currently have log cabins on sale. Read the latest log cabin for sale and log cabin builds from Timber Building Specialists. Keep up-to-date with all the latest news and fitting jobs from the Timber Building Specialists blog. Offers, promotions, and our latest garden log cabin fit and summer houses

feeds.title: Gingrich Builders Blog
feeds.description: Gingrich Builders has more than 45 years of experience as the leading log home builder in PA. We've earned our first-class reputation by designing and creating dream-come-true log homes -for people just like you. Read our log home living blog for tips & advice from the experienced log home builders at Gingrich Builders.

feeds.title: Woodworkers Shoppe
feeds.description: With our interior and exterior wood paneling and siding, you can make 'Any Home a Log Home' for a splinter of the cost of a full log home! We are the leaders in Log Home Products! We have helpful articles on woodworking and tips on home remodeling to help you with log cabin renovation. Read the Woodworkers Shoppe's blog!

feeds.title: Kealey Tackaberry Log Homes Blog
feeds.description: Kealey & Tackaberry Log Homes is a family-operated business situated just west of Ottawa. We supply and build complete handcrafted and milled log homes. With the use of natural, non-manufactured materials, the homes we build are virtually free of toxins normally associated with new construction and thus provide excellent indoor air quality. Find about Ontario's leading supplier of sustainable designed Log or Timber Homes, Log Cabins, and Log Cottages.

feeds.title: Beaver Mountain Blog
feeds.description: At Beaver Mountain, our in-house architectural design team will create a custom-designed luxury log home or timber home custom-built for your lifestyle. Inspired by your imagination, your custom-crafted log home will be designed and built to reflect your vision, elevate your quality of life, and create an enduring legacy for the next generation. Check out our blog for the latest news and inspiration.

feeds.title: We Fix Log Homes
feeds.description: The Performance Log Finishers team, led by Ian Wenzel, has decades of experience maintaining, renovating, and building virtually every type of log home. Because of our years of experience, and our dedication to constantly learning and mastering new techniques and product applications, our clients say we bring a higher level of knowledge and expertise to log-home projects. Owning a log home means you have maintenance other homeowners don't worry about. Get the best tips and news from We Fix Log Homes.

feeds.title: Log Cabin Hub Blog
feeds.description: The Log Cabin Hub is a digital publication aimed at cabin builders, homesteaders, lumberjacks, and anyone else with an interest in log cabins. At the Log Cabin Hub, we have EVERYTHING you need to build your first log cabin. The blog is typically updated fortnightly with new articles on a large variety of cabin and off-grid living topics covering: Log Cabin Plans, Building Log Cabins, Cabin Kits, etc

feeds.title: Honest Abe Blog
feeds.description: We offer a variety of ways to help you make informed decisions about log homes. You're invited to tour our plant, meet our people, attend special events and register for free educational information. Honest Abe's Log Home Blog shares stories from Honest Abe Living Magazine, company news, announcements, and photos from new construction & new house plans.

feeds.title: Log Cabin Store Blog
feeds.description: Garden log cabins are designed to be protected against all kinds of weather. Our cabins are built purposely to be weatherproof, this means that even throughout the worst and harshest of UK weather, this will not affect the resilience and durability of your log cabin. Find the latest News from the Log Cabin store, featuring our best log cabin picks ideas for your log cabin and more. We update our log cabin blog on a regular basis to keep our customers informed on some of the best uses for our products along with any news and product updates within the outdoor building industry.

feeds.title: Log Cabin Specialists
feeds.description: Our log cabins are completely bespoke and can be customized to any size, log thickness, or finish. We have over 20 years of experience in the industry so we know what works best for our customers. Read the latest log cabin builds from the Log Cabin Specialists and the latest customer photos of their Log Cabin Kits.

feeds.title: Tuindeco Blog
feeds.description: TuinDeco is Europe's foremost supplier of log cabins, timber, fencing, structures, furniture, garden products, etc. Tuindeco has built a reputation for its high standards and only supply the best at the best prices. Tuindeco Blog is a place where you will find plenty of articles of advice and tips for all things Tuin Log Cabins.

feeds.title: Keops Blog
feeds.description: We are a family business with a chartered engineering background and have been in the business of selling log cabins for over twenty-two years. During this time an incredible amount of research has taken place and a great deal of experience has been gained. In other words, we have done all the hard work for you, just tell us what you'd like and we'll do the rest.

feeds.title: The Cabin Diary
feeds.description: The Cabin Diary is here to give you inspiration, resources, and community. The Cabin Diary shares all things cabin living: from cabin decor and recipes to resources for cabin owners and stories of living in cabins. Discover the best of log cabin living, cabin decor, recipes, daily cabin life & more. Whether you live in a cabin or want to move to one, explore our resource for all things cabin.

feeds.title: Appalachian Log Homes Blog
feeds.description: Since 1980 Appalachian Log and Timber homes have been ensuring our clients with the highest quality craftsmanship. We pride ourselves on the relationships we have created. Serving our patrons with honesty, integrity, and the exceptional quality they expect. Honoring the Appalachian style of our forefathers is our foundation, all while delivering the current styles of today.
